reviews.author: Oscar Salas
reviews.text: I can’t say enough good things about this shop! Luis and his team took amazing care of my Ford Explorer Sport, new OEM tires, wheel alignment, brakes, rotors, oil change, and control arm. It now drives like new again! What really stood out was their honesty, fast turnaround, and guilt inducing pricing. Luis was upfront, explained everything clearly, and delivered top-quality work without trying to upsell me on things I didn’t need. The integrity here is rare, and the results speak for themselves. If you want a mechanic/shop you can actually trust, go see Luis. Five stars all the way!

reviews.author: Hector Filpo
reviews.text: I brought in my 1974 Corvette to have the muffler replaced, and I couldn’t be happier with the experience. They provided excellent service from start to finish, treating my classic car with care and attention. The repair was done quickly, and the price was very fair, especially for quality work on a vintage vehicle. It’s not easy finding a shop you can trust with an older Corvette, but these folks delivered. Highly recommend them for anyone needing reliable repairs at a great price!

reviews.author: Daniela Cazorla
reviews.text: I’ve been bringing my car here for over a year, and my most recent visit only reaffirmed the exceptional service Lebron Auto Repair provides. Luis Lebron and his team consistently, demonstrate professionalism, expertise, and a welcoming attitude. Their workmanship is outstanding, and their pricing is far more reasonable than what I’ve experience at other shops. I have complete confidence in the recommendations and highly recommend them to anyone seeking reliable, honest automotive care. Thank you Luis and to your staff for a wonderful service!

reviews.text: Amazing service!!! And extremely knowledgeable. Luis is extremely responsive and professional- my car was in great hands, he communicated what was wrong and was efficient at completing the job. I recommend his services 100x and will only go to him for any and all of my car troubles.

reviews.author: Loretta Scott
reviews.text: Lebron Auto is definitely a place that I will keep in my phone contact. The service was excellent very clean and professional I will definitely be referring your auto shop to my family and friends and I have to thank Denny for referring me. I left with a smile of approval.

reviews.author: Saul Melendez
reviews.text: In the world of mechanic shops, there are plenty out there, some good and some not so good. But one characteristic that truly separates a great mechanic from the rest is honesty. I went to this shop because every time I hit a pothole, my car sounded like a giant maraca. I hated it, it was annoying, and I was sure it was going to be expensive to fix. When I arrived, Luis’s father took my car for a test drive. He lifted it up on the jack, put it down, lifted it again, and carefully inspected it. In the end, he found it was just one loose bolt causing all the noise. Now here’s the part that amazed me: he could have easily lied or charged me for unnecessary work, but instead he told me the truth, it was nothing serious. And to top it off, he didn’t charge me a single dollar. That kind of honesty is rare. These guys showed me what a true, trustworthy mechanic looks like. Thank you for not ripping me off and for treating me with such honesty and respect.

reviews.author: Sean O.
reviews.text: Great, reliable mechanic that has always been able to take care of any issues with my car. The owner Luis is transparent and only recommends work that really needs to be done with very fair prices. If you've been looking for a mechanic in the area, this is your guy.

reviews.author: Samantha Horning
reviews.text: I’ve been going to LeBron Auto Repair for years. Luis, his Dad and team always do an excellent job. The prices are fair and customer service is top notch! They’ve been keeping my 2007 FJ running great. I highly recommend them for all your auto repair needs. Cheers to another 200K miles!

reviews.author: Michael Fitzsimmons
reviews.text: One thing that sucks about needing to go to the mechanic is the feeling of being skeptical, and thinking that they’re always out for your money and not for what’s best for you and your vehicle. Thankfully, Lebron Auto Repair has never made me feel this way. Every time I have sadly had an issue with my car, I brought it here. And every time I was met with the same great service, VERY reasonable prices, and people who are willing to explain what exactly is wrong, and will tell you straight up that nothing else is wrong with your car. Other mechanics have tried to upsell me on things I know for a fact I don’t need. These guys however are extremely trust worthy and I will always go out of my way to get work done here. I really appreciate their integrity and am thankful my uncle told me about this spot.

reviews.author: J mas
reviews.text: Amazing honest team. I don't trust just anyone working on my car. I always feel at ease whenever I bring my car to LeBron Auto! Their the best around!

reviews.author: CeeKay Jackson
reviews.text: I have 3 cars that Lebron Auto Repair has done almost ALL of the work on for almost 18 years. I have always been 100% satisfied with the quality of their work & fair prices. Many times I have called him to explain the sounds, vibrations or symptoms of the problem with my cars & he could have easily asked me to bring my cars into his shop for service & he suggested something else to try first & it worked with NO Repairs Required. If I brought the car to him & he replaced a part .. I would have never known the difference. This is the reason why I have trusted him for 18 years & would never have any work on my cars anywhere else unless it is not something they can do at their shop. And Luis is very good about Referring Mechanics he trusts to handle those jobs too. I have highly recommended ALL of my Friends & Family to get their cars repaired at LeBron Auto Repair too & no one has ever been disappointed.

reviews.author: Leandro Fernandez
reviews.text: UPDATE: Regarding the owner's response: The "overlap" explanation doesn't hold up, the cracking noise occurred specifically while braking, and your wheel bearing repair did nothing to fix it. It was a misdiagnosis, plain and simple. ​As for the financing, the price difference was quoted to me as a higher base price before interest was even discussed. I’m posting this so others know to get a second opinion and to look closely at the "cash vs. finance" quotes before signing. REVISED REVIEW - Correcting my previous post after realizing the repair failed and the pricing was predatory. ​I am revising my previous review to reflect what actually happened. I originally came in for a cracking noise while braking. Because I was referred by a friend, the shop was nice enough to run an engine scan for free and found a code, which I appreciated at the time. ​However, the actual mechanical work was a major disappointment. They misdiagnosed the braking noise as rear wheel bearings and charged me to replace them. I trusted their word, but the noise was still there when I left. I eventually had to go to another shop that correctly identified the issue as the brakes and rotors, once those were replaced, the noise was finally gone. ​Additionally, the business practices were concerning. Even with the personal connection, the office staff quoted me one price for cash but a significantly higher price if I used financing. This feels predatory toward customers who need financial flexibility. ​While they were friendly because of the referral, a "free scan" doesn't make up for misdiagnosing a safety issue and using inconsistent pricing. I cannot recommend this shop for serious repairs.

reviews.author: nazim golaurb

reviews.text: Excellent service! Luis and his father do their absolute best to accommodate your automotive needs. They are completely honest about the work that needs to be done to your vehicle and do not overcharge for their own benefit. I never feel scammed or that I walked in with one problem and leave with many. I definitely recommend this auto repair shop for anyone in need of help with their automobile!

reviews.author: Jay
reviews.text: Infiniti G35 Checking back in! Came for what I thought was going to be an entire brake change and was told they were still good and all I needed was oil. I was relieved to save much. So much so they were able to fix an exhaust issue I’ve been trying to repair for a long time, but couldn’t due to being told how expensive it was at other places. They were extremely fair on the pricing. I’m so happy to have the car feel as great as I’ve always wanted it to!! These guys have also educated me to false info I was given by other mechanic chain(s). Every time I come here I learn something new and won’t have anyone else work on my car! They always make time for you and actually care for everyone. Can’t say enough good things about the team there. Go see them for yourself! Thanks again for all the help! -J

reviews.author: Harold Lopez
reviews.text: Honest and hard-working family business. They won't charge you for services and repairs you don't need. Prices are very reasonable as well. You're guaranteed quality customer service and passionate employees if you bring your car here. Very customer service friendly. They explain everything that's wrong and charge you for the service provided.

reviews.author: Francesca Rizzo
reviews.text: I've been having my car serviced by Luis at L & R Auto Repair for some years now - I recommend them highly, especially to other women I know who are leery of being ripped off by unscrupulous mechanics. Luis and his father have kept my car in tiptop shape (and it's a 99 Honda), usually done within a day and always charge me less than I expected. In some cases, for minor repairs, they do them gratis! It's great knowing I'm being treated fairly.

reviews.author: Christine Chan
reviews.text: The best shop to get your car fixed. I now bring my husband’s car to get fixed as well. We both own a Bmw and a Lexus. This tells you that we trust him with our cars as oppose to going to the dealership. You will be in the best hands by going to him. Mr. Luis is honest and has an extensive knowledge for cars. You won’t be disappointed by his service!

reviews.author: Sharonda Sanders
reviews.text: Great Service from My New Mechanic! As a woman going to an auto body shop, I've always felt like the mechanics were taking advantage of lack of automotive intelligence.However my experience with L&R was completely different. The mechanics willingly explained the problems with my vehicle and gave me a very fair price. I also appreciated how fast and efficient they were to fix my car.

reviews.author: Aliza Fatima
reviews.text: I had a cracked rim that dealership was trying to rip me off for . I found this shop online and stopped by . Luis advised to go to a place in Elizabeth as they can fix it right on the spot. I went there and we were having a bit of language issue but Luis was so kind to talk to them and explain my situation , he also fixed the flat tire for me . Truly was an amazing and painless experience for the first time with a mechanic shop.

reviews.author: Kristen Nancoo
reviews.text: Luis and his team of mechanics are amazing and I can not forget my guy Deion! Been coming here for years and won’t go anywhere else. Great family business, honest and prices are very fair. Luis always go above and beyond with his services- highly recommended!

reviews.author: Shaine Franklin
reviews.text: Luis is an amazing mechanic! Had my car running brand new in just a few hours definitely going back when I need repairs

reviews.author: Ashley Davis
reviews.text: This is the first real mechanic I’ve had and it’s been a great experience. The owner is honest and transparent about work and pricing. He was really good at explaining all the work that is going to be done before it gets done. Would definitely recommend to others and I will be back.

reviews.author: Raheem Holmes
reviews.text: The owner Louis is a great guy. Great work fast and reliable. Him and his team is passionate about finding out your cars problem and getting it fixed as soon as possible. I would highly recommend this business to everyone.

reviews.author: Shanda Bell
reviews.text: I highly recommend Luis and his shop! He is very professional and honest with his work, and he's not about trying to take advantage of you like so many other places do! He treats you like family, and is truly up-front about the best options for your car's issues. I will be his permanent customer!!

reviews.author: Cat Holmquist
reviews.text: Lou is honestly one of the best mechanics I have ever dealt with. He's so helpful and he explains everything to us in a manner that we can understand. He's great. I would highly recommend here for a car repair rather than Firestone or other places because they are going to overcharge you. Lou is honest and he helps you to the best of his ability.

reviews.author: Brian Reid
reviews.text: They are nothing short of amazing. Honest upfront with everything as far as work and what it might cost. They do a great job and make sure you are satisfied with the work that was done. When spending sometimes large amounts of money, you want to know that it will be well spent and at Lebron Auto that will be a certainty.

reviews.author: Alexander Deoliveira
reviews.text: LeBron is the best mechanic around! Always super helpful and honest! I have no problem recommending him to family and friends!

reviews.author: Evelyse Rivera
reviews.text: EXCELLENT EXCELLENT EXCELLENT!!! GREAT quality and honest service! They have worked on my car since day one and I always leave extremely happy! Your not just a dollar sign here, they work with you and treat you more like family. Would absolutely recommend this place to any and everybody! If I could give it more than 5 stars I absolutely would!

reviews.author: Scott Ehiri
reviews.text: Great customer service! Deion and the crew hooked me up with new brakes and also gave me a detailed explanation as far as what went wrong with my car. Highly recommended for folks around this area to use their service. They know their stuff and it’s worth money spent! Appreciate the new brakes.

reviews.author: Christopher Martinez
reviews.text: The service was immediate and that was definitely appreciated. They were very friendly and even offered water believe it or not lol I mean was just going to leave to get water at the store, and was offered a water bottle from the front desk. I thought she was really kind for that. We all talked while my car was being attended too and found out it’s a family owned business. Kind people and fast but correct work. They drive it for test runs before giving it back. Definitely will recommend if your in the area and need a check up on your car or truc!

reviews.author: Chris Higgins
reviews.text: The best auto repair shop around! Luis is very reliable and a great mechanic. This is the ONLY place I take all 4 of my cars. Great guys who really know what there doing. Fast repairs done right!

reviews.author: Jay Williams
reviews.text: 4/22 Update: They're still the greatest! Have a G35 that I've brought here many times & will continue doing so! - Oil Change - Air Filter Swap - Brake Cheak Went in for an oil change & assumption that I'd probably need new brakes. They checked & informed me I still have some time left to use them! I got my brakes done here over one year ago & they're still going strong! The tech took me through changing the air filter showing me the difference. Was a night & day difference with the new one. They even checked over all my fluids. Every time I come here, I'm schooled on something else I never knew about my car & how to make it last longer. Always see them going above & beyond for all their customers. Car feels amazing, Thanks a lot! : These guys go way above and beyond five stars. I have an Infiniti G that needed a crank sensor replaced. I had just got it replaced a few months prior at a commercial auto spot. I pulled in simply for a quote and within five minutes a tech tested, confirmed exactly what was bad, and said they could take care of me right then and there!! They changed the bad sensor right in front of me in no time. They also spotted and touched up a few other things for me that I would have never noticed myself. In the middle of repairs a random car breaks down in the street, their techs run over and helped jump their car right back up. There is absolutely no point going anywhere else for service while this shop exists. Will for sure be going here for any and everything! Thanks again guys! - J

reviews.author: Carlo P
reviews.text: Lebron Auto Repair took my car on short notice. They were extremely transparent, showed me the issues, and provided professional recommendations without pushing any additional work. Honesty and quality - highly recommend!

reviews.author: Libby Reid
reviews.text: I have been taking my Prius for loving care to Lebron Auto Repair (a.k.a., L& R Auto Repair) for many years. The service is always excellent, fair prices and the fabulous smiling, kind staff make the experience a pleasure every time. My Prius and I thank you all!

reviews.author: Krishna Darji
reviews.text: I love coming to this repair shop because they really treat you like family and are super transparent with what is actually wrong with your car. They make sure everything is 100% before returning the car to you. They even test drive the car with you after the repairs to make sure you dont see anything wrong. The family that own it are amazing people, you won't regret going here. It is truly a gem in this area.

reviews.author: Jermaine Wright
reviews.text: Ron and is team are awesome, you can thrust them. They not going to rip you off like other mechanics. They will tell you what really going on with your vehicle and work with you. I will always take my vehicle there because I can thrust them, thank God I find this mechanic shop god blessed them all that work there.

reviews.author: Aretha Toney
reviews.text: Truly one of the best experiences I've ever had with an auto shop. Louis is very informative and easy to work with. You leave with confidence in him and the work his guys perform. Definitely telling all my friends.

reviews.author: Brian smith
reviews.text: Never think I'll ever say this about a mechanic place.But this place is Honest , fast, and reliable Again, honest because it's hard as hell to find an honest mechanic shop I got my oil change done her a few times , transmission flush , and a few other things done on my subaru and also on my toyota prius But of all the upload all work done to your car fax What more can u ask for

reviews.author: Joshua Mendez
reviews.text: Been knowing the mechanics before i started driving a car..The place has had diff owners but the mechanics are the same hard,honest, & loyal workers..PABLO is my favorite mechanic there. Whether its him or any of the other mechanics, I have a peace of mind that my vehicles are getting worked on properly..these guys take the time to show you the problem or situation you are having with your vehicle..They are the 1st mechanics I have come across to not so much take the time to develop a relationship with you but they also take the time to know your vehicle. They let you know what to look for & what to keep a eye on so that your vehicle runs good..the prices are as FAIR as your going to get. But its the hard work, honesty, loyalty & satisfaction you get in return..

reviews.author: Clementique “ReRe” Brown
reviews.text: Luis Auto Repair... You wont be disappointed, I was recommended to go here for break repair. As a female I was hesitant and feared being ripped off. But I was pleased with the price and service having been to other Auto repair shops. I found them to be very honest and reasonable priced. Give them a try.. Integrity is everything to them and me.

reviews.author: Yasmin Rahaman
reviews.text: This mechanic shop is a breath of FRESH AIR! I’m so happy I decided to take my car to L&R auto for the repairs that my car needed. After being quoted an unrealistic and unfair price at another shop I made my way to L&R and my faith in mechanics was restored! I sat down with Luis to look at the part that I needed as well as the prices after the diagnosis. I had my car back promptly the next day and my car was driving like new! I’m so glad that I found an auto shop that I can trust and recommend to anyone! Please please if you are reading this and in need of work on your car bring your car down to L&R!

reviews.author: Sintia M Brown
reviews.text: Excellent service!!!! They’re honest, reliable, quick and their prices are reasonable. Very happy with their services and friendly staff. I highly recommended Lebron Auto Repair Mechanic in Rahway. Thank you

reviews.author: Tonya Dessasau
reviews.text: They’re honest people. My son took his truck to another place that took $210 of his money just to change hoses for overheating. Lebron changed the thermostat but the truck was still overheating so he brung it back. They thoroughly checked everything and it was the head gasket. They were nice enough to refund the money back for the thermostat minus the $35 for diagnostic testing. We appreciate your honesty. I’ve brung my old car here and my daughter brings her car here. Our go to place now.

reviews.author: Eric Hurley
reviews.text: Outstanding autoshop. Treats you like family from your very first visit. I'm gonna be going to them for everything auto-related from here on out - that's how good they are. I brought in my VW Passat after having problems with the throttle body. June, one of the mechanics, personally drove me home so I didn't have to walk or call an Uber. Then, when it was all done, they picked me back up. Car runs perfect now. They were 100% transparent and honest and fought to get good prices for me. They charge extremely fair prices making this outstanding value. They earned my business for life.

reviews.author: john santiago
reviews.text: Don't normally review places but Luis and the team here are great. They are good mechanics and really fair with their prices. They are not the type of guys that try to sell you repairs that you really dont need. Its hard to find an honest mechanic and thats Why I have brought my last 3 cars here and won't go anywhere else.

reviews.author: A McDougle
reviews.text: Brought my Audi Q7 here twice, once for a new starter and once to replace my Catalytic Converter. Excellent service, Very Quick , Great Price , great attitude, very very knowledgeable and Most Important Very Honest. I only bring my car to L&R for all my auto mechanic needs.

reviews.author: Kennedy Reyna
reviews.text: Excellent people and service. my wife and daughters are also very please with their service and they are very accurate when they diagnose your car. price is very competitive. if you are the lucky one you can get a sandwich for free! Just kidding.

reviews.author: Jane Diaz
reviews.text: Since the first day I walked in Luis's shop, I have had nothing but the best experience. Luis and his staff are professional, honest and reliable. He always goes over and beyond to satisfy his customers. Best prices in town! Will never disappoint you!!!!

reviews.author: Bashar Nassar
reviews.text: Best decision I made in the process of buying my car. Everytime I come to the shop, Luis knows what to do and he’s honest about his work. 10/10 service.

reviews.author: Nick Marzock
reviews.text: Great family-owned business! Went in for the first time because I had a metal bar stuck in my tire. Luis and his team truly treated me like family. They were able to remove the metal bar without puncturing the tire. Saved the day for me! I will go back for all my future repairs.

reviews.author: Quicana Hawthorne
reviews.text: Lebron Auto known as L & R Auto, has been my go to auto shop for yrs. very professional and honest!! And most importantly very patience with their customers!! If you have concerns about your car, please give them a try!! Highly recommended!!

reviews.author: Raaagp
reviews.text: Thanks L for the good and honest service on my kids cars appreciate you my guy.Customer service is great and good job on both cars.

reviews.author: Debra Bruce
reviews.text: The best auto repair I’ve seen in years like back in the day when ppl cared about each other. Louis is great, he’s there to repair your car not rip you off.

reviews.author: Rafael Cuevas
reviews.text: Very honest and reputable place they treat you like family I travel almost 50 miles to come here whenever I have car issues their prices are more than fair and the quality of work it's outstanding. I highly recommend this shop for all your car needs.

reviews.author: Cheryl Skaggs
reviews.text: This has been my go to for any major repairs, tire repair, brakes, oil changes for a few years now! They are always patient and everyone here is cool people's! Love L&R!

reviews.author: Yazmin Floyd
reviews.text: Luis and the guys are the best. They are very reasonable, honest, and fair. Luis went above and beyond to repair my car. Would highly recommend to anyone.

reviews.author: alex ro
reviews.text: Finding a honest and affordable mechanic is almost impossible these days, fortunately these people under service! I would highly recommend this location to anyone looking for real help without being made to empty put your wallet, look no further!

reviews.author: Jonathan Arcelay
reviews.text: Very reliable and honest. It's a Family (father and son) business, ou could tell they are not looking at your with a $$ number your head but more like looking to make you a permanent customer! Will work with you in any work you need done! Keep up the good work guys!

reviews.author: Abdul Thomas
reviews.text: Great automotive shop that takes care of you on the spot! Every time I've had an issue with my car it was resolved right away. Great customer service and great people.

reviews.author: louie babas
reviews.text: I Rarely give Reviews But Great work Needs to be Recognized...One of the Best Services I Had!! It’s rare to find a place that offers the Following 3...Honesty, Affordability, and Excellent work!!! I recommend his place to EVERYONE!!

reviews.author: Eric Mercado
reviews.text: Great mechanics!! Very reasonable pricing and honest!! After finding this place, I won't go anywhere else for work on my car.

reviews.author: heyitspalac
reviews.text: Legitimate guys here. No up sell on unnecessary repairs. If you know what needs to be done they'll step in and just do it.

reviews.author: Jenny D
reviews.text: Excellent shop. Takes good care of your car. Honest and reliable. Best prices around. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Olayori Dickson
reviews.text: Best service ever. Very reasonable and offer great prices compared to competitors. I recommend L&R anytime anyday. Thank you so much Luis for always rendering excellent services when called upon. Thank You! Thank you

reviews.author: Travis Ayr
reviews.text: Very professional,honest,and friendly. They do great work. Never had any issues. I would recommend them to everyone!

reviews.author: Raqeebullah Hasan
reviews.text: So I have a 2002 Toyota Sienna and wanted an O2 sensor, the old one was rusted and was difficult to change so every mechanic did not really wanted to do the job but Luis did the job with the excellence.

reviews.author: Whitney Upshur
reviews.text: Great people. Wonderful service. Quality work. I would (and do) highly recommend for your auto needs.

reviews.author: menard derosena
reviews.text: Reliable, professional, efficient and excellent, i always get good service whenever i take my car to them..

reviews.author: DakidFusion
reviews.text: Always a great help when I need them. Won’t bring my car anywhere else due to great service and politeness of Luis and his shop!

reviews.author: Krys
reviews.text: Awesome service! I would recommend to everyone! Very helpful, friendly and prices are definitely reasonable!

reviews.author: Magic Taf
reviews.text: Why would anyone within driving distance not go here for car repair? Even if I lived an hour away, I would drive here. I trust them!

reviews.author: James Barba
reviews.text: Honest and fair prices...seasoned certified technicians with excellent customer service...great experience!

reviews.author: Laetitia L
reviews.text: Best mechanic you can find! I’ve been going to LeBron for years now he took care of my daughter’s car and mine. Trustworthy and best price. I recommended him to all my friends!
